top_signals.title: Saudis Make Deal With Japan to Replenish Depleted Oil Stockpiles
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia reached an agreement to help replenish Japan’s depleted crude stockpiles and expand the kingdom’s own storage capacity in the Asian country.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Wasps submit training centre plans as rugby club targets return to Prem
top_signals.summary: Wasps have announced “a meaningful step forward” in their plans to resurrect the iconic rugby club after applying for permission to build a training centre in Swanley, Kent. top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: F5 releases emergency patches for critical BIG-IP RCE flaws
top_signals.summary: US cybersecurity company F5 warned customers to patch five critical BIG-IP vulnerabilities that attackers can exploit to trigger denial-of-service (DoS) or gain remote code execution. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: VanEck to end Gemini ETF custody deals, keeps Coinbase
top_signals.summary: VanEck plans to end Gemini’s custody agreements for three crypto ETFs in February 2027, while Coinbase will continue serving as a custodian for the funds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
